history.basis: filled-cap measurement, pigment absent (no pigment existed)

method: Median of batch medians: createVortex seed 970 at 1000x700, 240 warm-up frames of the #1810 bench script (4 scripted marks/frame, wetAdvect 0.6), then 5 batches x 60 steps timed with performance.now. Pigment-live runs use the same script with tint on every mark; pigment ends up across 9,463 of 16,384 cells (~58%). Sandbox node on a shared VM (a second builder was active); CI/device numbers remain the #1695 harness's to confirm.

registered.basis: pigment-live worst case per the #1810 convention (filled cap over steady state); midpoint of the two live medians, rounded
